card.name: Linking words after a time span
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as after, of, following and 's right after a time span or period (months, days, first month, time), just before a treatment or dose event.

modes.label: After a duration
modes.description: after or following placed right after a count of days or months, before dosing or therapy.
modes.example: symptom onset occurred a median of 71 days<< following>> dosing.

modes.label: Of after a period
modes.description: of after a time word, leading into therapy, treatment start or last dose.
modes.example: Perform complete blood counts weekly for the first month<< of>> therapy and then monthly thereafter, or as
